# reolink_camera_info (Data Source)

Reads model, hardware, and firmware metadata from a Reolink camera using GetDevInfo.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "reolink_camera_info" "front" {
  camera = "front"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `camera` (String) Key in the provider cameras map.

### Read-Only

- `build_day` (String) Firmware build date reported by the camera.
- `channel_count` (Number) Number of camera channels.
- `config_version` (String) Configuration version.
- `exact_type` (String) Camera-reported exact device type.
- `firmware_version` (String) Firmware version.
- `hardware_version` (String) Hardware version.
- `model` (String) Camera model.
- `name` (String) Camera-reported device name.
